properties.label: Building A tower
properties.source: traced: Lake Merritt BART TOD, City of Oakland Design Review Committee staff report, Apr 14, 2021 (PLN20038), with the Preliminary Development Plan set, sheet C4.1 (Vesting Tentative Tract Map, Block 1), PDF p. 81; tower set back 26'-7" from the lot's west line per sheet A2.13 (PDF p. 94); height: staff report p. 8, “Building A: 275 ft”
properties.note: 28 stories; 360 homes in the 2021 plan. BART's upcoming-projects page now lists a 439-home market-rate building here.

properties.label: Building A base
properties.source: traced: Lake Merritt BART TOD, City of Oakland Design Review Committee staff report, Apr 14, 2021 (PLN20038), with the Preliminary Development Plan set, sheet C4.1 (Vesting Tentative Tract Map, Block 1), PDF p. 81; height: staff report p. 8, building base “Building A: 48 ft”

properties.label: Building B (Chinatown senior homes)
properties.source: traced: Lake Merritt BART TOD, City of Oakland Design Review Committee staff report, Apr 14, 2021 (PLN20038), with the Preliminary Development Plan set, sheet C4.1 (Vesting Tentative Tract Map, Block 1), PDF p. 81 (Lot 2); height: staff report p. 8, “Building B: 83 ft”; under construction per BART (https://www.bart.gov/about/business/tod/lakemerritt)
properties.note: 7 stories, 97 affordable senior homes. BART's pages give the construction start as October 2024 (project page) and June 2025 (upcoming-projects page). The lot is drawn; the building is slightly smaller.

properties.label: Building C tower (office)
properties.source: traced: Lake Merritt BART TOD, City of Oakland Design Review Committee staff report, Apr 14, 2021 (PLN20038), with the Preliminary Development Plan set, sheet C4.2 (Vesting Tentative Tract Map, Block 2), PDF p. 82; tower set back 22'-8" from the west lot line and 11'-0" from Oak Street per sheet A2.33 (floors 4-12, PDF p. 109); height: staff report p. 8, “Building C: 275 ft”
properties.note: 19 stories, up to 500,000 sq ft of office (City of Oakland). Upper floors may step in further; drawn at the floors 4-12 outline.

properties.source: traced: Lake Merritt BART TOD, City of Oakland Design Review Committee staff report, Apr 14, 2021 (PLN20038), with the Preliminary Development Plan set, sheet C4.2 (Vesting Tentative Tract Map, Block 2), PDF p. 82; height: staff report p. 8, building base “Building C: 45 ft”

properties.label: Building D (family homes)
properties.source: traced: Lake Merritt BART TOD, City of Oakland Design Review Committee staff report, Apr 14, 2021 (PLN20038), with the Preliminary Development Plan set, sheet C4.2 (Vesting Tentative Tract Map, Block 2), PDF p. 82 (Lot 2, 24,810 sq ft, split from Lot 1 along the 200-ft lot line); height: staff report p. 8, “Building D: 83 ft”
